name: PatH
biography: Pat is a loving partner, a comedian to his daughter, and a dedicated ball retriever to his dog. When he's not spending time being those things, he's a senior security researcher at a public cybersecurity company. Having previously worked as a low-level software dev, he now helps threat hunters uncover and stop advanced actors across the globe.
